answer: Mechanism: locality-priced ember credits. Each action consumes ember credits priced by a convex curve over its shared compute pool (mesa). A raven daemon maps infrastructure reuse—IP/ASN, payment rails, scheduler affinity—and assigns a pooling coefficient. More identities sharing a mesa raise that coefficient, so marginal ember cost grows superlinearly; honest agents diversify infrastructure to lower costs. Attackers must pay escalating credits or provision independent pools, making N sybils cost far more than N.
